label: row_0
context: This table reports second-order rate constants for methoxide-promoted methanolysis of trifluoroacetanilides bearing various ring substituents on the aniline moiety. Electron-withdrawing groups (e.g. m-NO₂, m-Br, m-Cl) stabilize the anilide leaving group by delocalizing developing negative charge during collapse of the tetrahedral intermediate, increasing the rate. Electron-donating groups destabilize the leaving group and slow the reaction. The trend reflects a Hammett-type dependence controlled by leaving-group stabilization in the elimination step.
